facts.text: Everybody in town thinks the sauce is a big secret. It is. Don't ask me.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Leona's words, but it is not a line from the film. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: The sauce is a secret and it stays a secret. Eat up before the critic gets here.
